answer: Clone desks still pour spare keys through one night window. A new identity may join only at a metered inlet that stamps 14 tickets an hour, each dyed with umber ink whose absorbance curve is logged every 18 minutes for 9 hours. The ticket sits on a four-level stake terrace (12, 24, 48, 96 POA) for 8 epochs before it can vote. Auditors replay the inlet stamp log against the ink-curve hash. Cost: 12 POA locked plus lost tickets on a hit. If two keys share a stamp, umber curves agree within 1.5%, or one shop fills three terrace levels, 58% of the bond burns and that series is barred for 6 epochs.
